nodes.description: A synthetic case file is open and unclassified.
Classify the synthetic case by its listed findings.
nodes.guidance: Read the findings table before classifying. Do not infer findings that are not listed.
nodes.pitfalls: Treat any variant of uncertain significance as unclassified, not actionable.

nodes.description: Draft a research summary for the synthetic case.
nodes.guidance: Label the draft as research and decision support. It is not clinical advice.
nodes.pitfalls: Do not include identifiers beyond the synthetic case code.

nodes.description: A draft summary exists and is unsigned.
Record a reviewer sign-off on the draft.
nodes.guidance: Sign-off requires a named reviewer placeholder.
nodes.pitfalls: Never sign off a draft that still contains an unclassified finding.

attrs.guidance: Only advance once every finding has a label.
